title: SafeLine ACL Rule Structure
description: JSON structure documentation for a SafeLine WAF access control list rule for blocking or allowing traffic

action.description: Action to take when rule matches: block, allow, or log

match_type.description: Type of match condition: ip, ip_range, country, url, user_agent, header

match_value.description: Value to match against (IP address, CIDR range, country code, URL pattern, etc.)

priority.description: Rule evaluation priority (lower number = higher priority)

enabled.description: Whether the rule is active and enforced

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the rule purpose

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the rule was created

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent rule modification
